name: Pumpkin Seeds (Pepitas)
siboNotes: Pumpkin seeds are FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated. High fiber content may cause digestive discomfort if consumed in large quantities.
preparationTips: Soak raw seeds overnight to improve digestibility
Roast with low-FODMAP seasonings like salt, paprika, or cumin
Store in airtight container to maintain freshness and prevent rancidity
Can be ground into flour or butter as alternatives to wheat flour or nut butters
nutritionalHighlights: Excellent source of magnesium and zinc
Rich in healthy monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats
